set.body:
Scope

Add S07, S10, and S16 as public-path scenario contracts proving the Phase 1 semantic spine.

Acceptance criteria

- [ ] S07 constructs a fully crossed 2x2 design from ordinary public APIs and verifies structural cells, main/simple/interaction hypotheses, joint F rank, design matrix, and planted effects.
- [ ] S10 distinguishes canonical coefficient, derivative coefficient, all-basis omnibus, response at time, response window mean, and FIR-window functionals.
- [ ] S16 includes duplicate columns, an empty cell, an all-zero modulator, a non-estimable hypothesis, and an estimable hypothesis.
- [ ] Rank-deficient comparisons target fitted values, residuals, projections/row space, rank, aliases, and estimable functions rather than arbitrary coefficients.
- [ ] Column and term permutations preserve semantic scenario results after structural alignment.
- [ ] No scenario uses numeric design-column indices, parses labels, manually synchronizes contrast order, or constructs a raw matrix except for an explicitly named independent fit oracle.
- [ ] Independent analytic/R/Nilearn references are labelled by what they prove: HRF, design, fit, or end-to-end.
- [ ] Each scenario returns one clean ScenarioResult, is registered in the manifest with receipts/commands, and passes on JVM and Scala.js.
- [ ] The scenarios use only published/public module surfaces and can serve as executable documentation.
set.title: P1.5: activate factorial, basis-aware, and rank-deficiency acceptance scenarios
